lore_leo_castle.text: I am King Leo. Do do you like my castle? Richard tells me you want to become a knight.

lore_leo_cedric1.text: My land is a wonderful place, but for Cedric and his gang. He’s always trying to get his hands on my Kingdom... and his bottom on my throne!

lore_leo_cedric2.text: For now though, Cedric still lives in the woods!

lore_queen_daughter.text: Have you met my daughter Princess Storm? Maybe later. Few can match her skills with a sword.

lore_queen_husband.text: You've met my husband. He can be a bit pompous you know! A fine king though!

lore_queen_self.text: I am Queen Leonora and I advise Leo on tactics.

lore_richard_cedric.text: Ignore Cedric!  Let me see Richard's new recruit!

lore_richard_friendsfoes.text: I’ll introduce you to some friends and foes along the way!

lore_richard_greet.text: Greetings! I am Richard the Strong, and I welcome you to LEGO Creator Knights' Kingdom.

lore_richard_reassure.text: Don’t worry. I’ll be here to help you throughout.
